name: skill-feedback
description: Capture and aggregate usage feedback for Agent Skills so the Skill Quality Gate loop can improve them over time. Use when a skill triggered wrongly, failed to trigger on a relevant request (near-miss), produced a wrong or broken output, or the user manually corrected its result. Writes structured entries to feedback/<skill>/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl and can summarize them into a report that feeds skill-forge's Optimize-description step. Requires Python 3 stdlib only.
author: bestdeejay-design
